HALLUCINATIONS:
- Claim of “125 basis points spread from Level 1 to Level 5.” Annex I shows Eurodollar margins of 0.725% (Level 1) and 1.225% (Level 5), a 50 bps difference; ABR margins are 0.000% (Level 1) and 0.225% (Level 5), a 22.5 bps difference.
